ERR_1104.title: SSO assertion rejected
ERR_1104.cause: The SAML assertion is missing the email attribute, or the clock skew between your identity provider and our servers is over five minutes.
steps: Confirm the IdP sends an `email` attribute in the assertion.
Check that both the IdP host and your local machine sync time via NTP.
Re-download the metadata XML and re-upload it under Settings > Security > SSO.
Sign in from an incognito window to avoid a cached session.

ERR_2031.title: Insufficient permissions
ERR_2031.cause: The signed-in role cannot perform this action. Invoices and team management are Owner/Admin only.
steps: Check your role under Settings > Team.
Ask an Owner or Admin to raise your role, or to perform the action for you.

ERR_3007.title: Import validation failed
ERR_3007.cause: The CSV has duplicate or empty column headers, or a date that is not ISO 8601. Nothing was written.
steps: Open the reported row number in the source file.
Make every column header unique and non-empty.
Reformat dates to YYYY-MM-DD and re-upload.

ERR_4029.title: Rate limit exceeded
ERR_4029.cause: More requests than the plan allows within the 10 second smoothing window.
steps: Honour the `Retry-After` header instead of retrying immediately.
Add exponential backoff with jitter to the client.
Batch reads where the API supports it.
Raise the plan if sustained throughput is genuinely needed.

ERR_5012.title: Upload rejected by storage
ERR_5012.cause: The upload was rejected before completing: the file exceeds the plan's per-file limit, the file type is not allowed, or the 15 minute upload token expired mid-transfer.
steps: Check the file size against your plan limit (100 MB Starter, 2 GB Pro/Business, 10 GB Enterprise).
Confirm the file type is on the allow list - no executables, nested archives, or extensionless files.
Retry the upload from a fresh page load so a new 15 minute token is issued.
For files over 500 MB, keep the tab in the foreground so the resumable chunked transfer is not throttled.
If it still fails, send support the file name, size, type and the timestamp of the attempt.

ERR_5108.title: Export archive too large
ERR_5108.cause: The generated export archive exceeded the 10 GB per-job limit.
steps: Narrow the export date range.
Export in parts and re-run.
Exclude attachments if you only need the records.

ERR_5140.title: Storage quota exhausted
ERR_5140.cause: The workspace has reached its total storage limit, so new writes to storage are rejected.
steps: Check Settings > Plan and usage for storage consumed.
Delete or archive large attachments, then empty the trash to reclaim space.
Raise the plan if usage is legitimate.

ERR_6002.title: Webhook endpoint unhealthy
ERR_6002.cause: Six consecutive delivery attempts failed over roughly 24 hours, so the endpoint was marked unhealthy and delivery paused.
steps: Confirm the endpoint returns 2xx within 5 seconds.
Check the signature verification is not rejecting valid events.
Re-enable the endpoint under Settings > Integrations > Webhooks and replay the missed events.

ERR_6015.title: Integration token revoked
ERR_6015.cause: The OAuth token for the integration was revoked upstream, usually because the granting account lost access on the other side.
steps: Reconnect the integration from Settings > Integrations.
Grant the scopes with an account that will stay active.

ERR_1077.title: Reset link expired
ERR_1077.cause: Password reset links are valid for one hour and single use.
steps: Request a fresh reset link.
Open it in the same browser you requested it from.
If SSO is enforced, sign in through the identity provider instead.

ERR_2044.title: Seat limit reached
ERR_2044.cause: The invitation could not be sent because every seat included in the plan is in use.
steps: Remove an inactive member to free a seat, or raise the plan.
Note that Viewers are free on Business and Enterprise and do not consume a seat.

ERR_3112.title: Payment method rejected
ERR_3112.cause: The card was declined, or the card type is not supported (prepaid cards and PayPal are not accepted).
steps: Update the card under Billing > Payment method - the open invoice retries immediately.
Ask the bank whether recurring international payments are blocked.
Add a backup card so a single decline does not interrupt service.
